thread:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert: `alerts.metric_pipeline.log_ingest_lag` fired for service=log-ingest-prod (severity=critical)

Alex W: getting a pd storm here, ~30 dup alerts in 2min. looks related to prometheus scrape failing for fluentd exporters across prod clusters.

pagerduty-bot: Alert dedup suppression attempted (rule=rapid-duplicate), some alerts still escalated due to different signatures.

Maria Chen: seeing high consumer lag on kafka topic `logs-ingest-main` in eu-west-1, retention build-up. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abcd/logs-ingest-overview

Alex W: confirmed, prometheus target `fluentd-exporter-prod` state=DOWN across ~8 nodes. pods show CrashLoopBackOff in k8s.

Priya S: i suspect a recent config rollout — 2am job pushed updated TLS cert rotation. any rollout notes?

Dan R: rollout history shows `fluentd-configmap` updated 00:52 UTC. linking helm diff: https://helm.redwood.company/revisions/helm-release-fluentd/145

Alex W: ok, immediate mitigation: silence PagerDuty for 15m, start rerouting log writes to fallback buffer, scale kafka consumers. @oncall-next please ack if you can take handoff. :pray:

oncall-next: acked. taking lead.

Maria Chen: running quick consumer scale:
```
kubectl scale deployment/log-consumers --replicas=12 -n ingest-prod
# checking consumer lag
kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --group logs-processor --describe | grep logs-ingest-main
```

Priya S: i'm kicking a controlled restart of fluentd daemonset on one node to capture logs and confirm config errors. doing canary first.

Alex W: also suppress the duplicate-alert noise -> I submitted PD mute on the service and created a temporary alert filter on prometheus: `alertmanager silence` applied.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Silence created by Alex W (15m) on service=log-ingest-prod, reason="mitigation in progress"

Dan R: looking at pod logs from fluentd: TLS handshake errors referencing expired cert for `client-proxy`. stack snippet:
```
2026-09-12T00:44:11Z error: tls: handshake failure: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
```

Maria Chen: that matches rollout diff — cert rotation failed to include new CA bundle. i can hotpatch the configmap with the proper CA and roll the daemonset.

Priya S: hotpatch applied to canary node, fluentd canary logs are flowing to kafka again. pushing to rest of nodes now.

Alex W: great. after patch, consumer lag trending down from 600k -> 120k in 8 min. keep scaling slightly to catch up.

oncall-next: i've updated incident status: "partial log ingestion degraded; customer read APIs may show delayed events up to ~10m for impacted orgs". notifying customer-ops.

Priya S: will follow-up with postmortem notes: immediate cause = cert rotation missing CA bundle in 00:52 rollout; PD escalation compounded by duplicate-alert triggers and alert dedup rules not catching signature shift.

Dan R: operational checklist I ran:
- scaled consumers
- canary patch applied
- rolled fluentd daemonset 8/8 nodes
- created PD silence
- opened postmortem doc: https://confluence.redwood.company/x/pm-logs-2026-09-12

Alex W: handing off to next oncall in 30m for verification and watch. thanks everyone. :tada:

oncall-next: handoff acknowledged. will monitor for 1h and close silence if stable.

incidentbot: Incident update: incident channel created #inc-log-ingest-1799000123; severity=high; current state=mitigated (monitoring).
